messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: automatic page fired: reserved-pool-latency for tenant=VerdantPay pool=verdant-reserved-3 metric=99th_p95_latency_ms > 5000 for 3m

pagerduty-bot: PD incident created (INC-7591). urgency=high, escalation_policy=oncall-platform. Notifying primary on-call.

Ben (oncall): Ack'd on PD. I'm on it — triaging now. ETA 5m.

Ben (oncall): quick check: queue depth on pool verdant-reserved-3 is spiking, worker GPU saturation ~= 92%, eviction spikes on KV cache. Kicking off diagnostics: 
```
# current queue lengths
kubectl get pods -l pool=verdant-reserved-3 -o jsonpath='{.items[*].status.containerStatuses[*].ready}'
# tail inference logs (last 100 lines)
kubectl logs pod/inf-verdant-3 --tail=100 | grep -i latency
```

Alice (SRE): grabbing infra metrics. seeing a pattern: shelling out 10m window - Avg token latency up x5, GC and GPU backpressure events around 16:03UTC. Also noticed kvcache compaction events at 16:00.

Clara (Customer Success): VerdantPay support channel: multiple customers complaining about slow payment authorizations and timeouts. They reported degradation starting ~15:58 UTC. Major merchant impact. Customer-facing severity: P1.

Marta (Platform): if KV eviction is flapping, requests rebuild entire prefix and amplify load. Possible root: one of their long-running prefixes causing cache churn. Suggest temporary mitigation: route a small percentage of VerdantPay traffic off this pool to backup reserved pool or to hosted fallback.

Ben (oncall): initiating traffic split 10% -> verdant-reserved-2 (backup), 5% -> hosted-fallback. Running admin command now: 
```
redwoodctl route update --tenant VerdantPay --pool verdant-reserved-3 --split 85,10,5 --dest verdant-reserved-2,hosted-fallback
```

pagerduty-bot: Escalation timer: next level in 5m if not acknowledged by responder.

Jenny (Support): pinging VerdantPay CSM to prep incident banner. Clara, can you draft a short note telling merchants we are investigating latency and routing some requests to a fallback?

Clara (Customer Success): drafting: "We're seeing increased latency on checkout for some merchants on VerdantPay. We've routed traffic to a fallback while we investigate. No card data exposure. We'll update in 30 min or sooner." Sending to Ben for technical accuracy. :white_check_mark:

Ben (oncall): update: after 10% diversion to verdant-reserved-2, p95 dropped from ~4.8s to ~1.2s for sampled requests. Error rates reduced but KV cache miss rate still elevated on primary pool. Looks like cascading regen load.

Kyle (Runtime): curious — any recent model or kernel changes rolled to verdant-reserved-3? I see a micro-quantization rollout yesterday at 02:00 UTC. Could be interacting with memory allocation. Also check per-shard KV TTLs.

Alice (SRE): no infra deploys since 14:30. Will inspect GPU driver logs and MIG health. Attaching snippet: 
```
[16:04:12] GPU0: stall detected, pending kernel wait 1234ms
[16:05:01] kvcache: eviction triggered, reclaimed 1.2GB
```

Ben (oncall): I'm bumping reserved concurrency for verdant-reserved-3 as a short-term safety: 
```
redwoodctl pool scale --pool verdant-reserved-3 --reserved-instances +2 --duration 30m
```

Marta (Platform): approved. Also enabling extra prefix cache slots for that pool (experimental TTL increase). Monitor for memory pressure.

pagerduty-bot: INC-7591 acknowledged by Ben (oncall). Escalation timers paused.

Clara (Customer Success): VerdantPay CSM confirmed the merchant-facing note posted at 16:20 UTC. Early customer reactions: grateful for prompt action but asking for root cause and SLA credit info.

Ben (oncall): current status: combination of KV cache churn + transient GPU backpressure. Mitigations in flight: traffic split, +2 reserved instances, prefix cache TTL adjusted. p95 and error rate trending down. Keeping pager open until stable for 30m.

Kyle (Runtime): setting up a more durable fix: rolling KV cache sticky assignment to avoid hot-prefix rebalances for VerdantPay. Will spin a canary config to 5% and watch.

Alice (SRE): alert noise reduced. No node-level OOMs. I'll keep driver logs and MIG telemetry in the incident channel.

Marta (Platform): follow-ups to create: (1) Postmortem with timeline, (2) Investigate why KV TTL defaults allowed churn, (3) Consider autoscale policy tweak for reserved pools with high prefix variance. I'll open tickets.

Ben (oncall): bringing this to close for the immediate page. Leaving tasks for follow-up. Drafting incident summary for PD and ops: 
- Impact: VerdantPay checkout latency elevated ~15:58-16:25 UTC affecting merchant flows.
- Mitigations: traffic split to backup + hosted fallback, temporary +2 reserved instances, increased cache TTL, canary KV sticky assignment.
- Status: regression observed -> mitigated, monitoring.

pagerduty-bot: INC-7591 status changed to 'acknowledged' -> 'resolved' by Ben (oncall) at 16:38 UTC.

Ben (oncall): :white_check_mark: closing thread. Creating follow-up jira: RDW-INC-7591-POST. Assigning to Marta/Kyle/Alice for RCA and customer comms.

Clara (Customer Success): I'll coordinate SLA/credit conversation and send a post-incident note to VerdantPay once RCA is ready. Thanks team. :pray:

incident-bot: automated note: incident channel will remain open for 24h for monitoring and follow-ups.

Ben (oncall): final note: if we see reoccurrence, immediate action is to failover all VerdantPay traffic to hosted-fallback and escalate to platform-intake.
